description: LPG monthly weight in kg, Jan - Jul 2026, supplied by the project owner on 2026-09-30 (19 kg cylinders). KG is the governed activity. The cylinder count and the source-reported emissions are kept as reference only; emissions are recalculated by the backend with the governed LPG_KG factor and compared with the source.

row_checks.description: KG equals cylinders used x cylinder size
cylinders used equals opening stock + purchase - closing stock

NO OF CYLINDER USED.note: Source-supplied cylinder count (19 kg cylinders); reference only, never a calculation input.

EMISSIONS TCO2E.note: Source-reported comparison only; the authoritative LPG emission is the backend calculation with the governed LPG_KG factor.
